upgrade.soloBannerTitle: Ready to expand? Upgrade to Full Mode
upgrade.soloBannerText: Unlock multiple stores, central warehouse inventory, and multi-user staff roles (cashiers, managers, supervisors). Your solo data is 100% preserved in place.
upgrade.title: Upgrade to Full Mode
upgrade.subtitle: Grow your business with multiple locations, warehouse logistics, and team staff.
upgrade.alreadyFullText: Your business is already running in Full Mode. You can manage your locations, team users, and module settings below.

features.multiStoreDesc: Run several branches from one unified system with individual store drawer counts and sales tracking.
features.warehouseDesc: Manage bulk stock, warehouse replenishment, and track inventory movements between locations.
features.staffDesc: Add Cashiers, Managers, and Supervisors with PIN approvals and tailored access levels.
features.shiftsDesc: Per-cashier drawer shifts with opening cash, counted cash, and discrepancy auditing.

upgrade.dataSafetyNote: All your existing products, variant barcodes, pricing, stock levels, past sales receipts, customer utang ledger records, and expense entries stay completely untouched on the same account. No data is moved or copied.
upgrade.enableWarehouseDesc: Allows creating warehouse locations and managing inventory transfers between facilities.
upgrade.addLocationPrompt: Add an additional location right now?
upgrade.addLocationHint: You can add a central warehouse or second branch now, or do it later in Locations.
upgrade.successText: Your business has been upgraded to Full Mode. You now have access to multi-location and team staff management.
